dish: Sōki soba — wide flat noodles with bone-in pork rib in bonito broth (billed as the 'original' sōki soba)
w: A Nago soba house founded in 1948 (formerly Ganaha Soba) that OTV Okitive presents as a 70-plus-year institution serving the 'original' sōki soba — flat wide noodles in a bonito-forward broth. Listed by the Nago City tourism association.

dish: Anettai brunch (choice of three toasts) and gapao rice with Yanbaru herbs, eaten in hammocks over the sea
n: Hammock Garden Anettai Chaya, Motobu (亜熱帯茶屋)
w: An Asian-style hillside café opened in May 2015 up a single-lane lane in Motobu, near Churaumi, with hammocks, arbours and mostly outdoor seats looking over forest and sea. Stars and Stripes Okinawa reviewed it for its food and coastal view; the OCVB, Mapple and Tabirai list its brunch toasts and Yanbaru-herb chicken gapao rice.
